template.name: Allergy-IntoleranceObservationV2
template.desc: This template reflects a discrete observation about a patient's allergy or intolerance. Because it is a discrete observation, it will have a statusCode of "completed". The effectiveTime, also referred to as the "biologically relevant time" is the time at which the observation holds for the patient. For a provider seeing a patient in the clinic today, observing a history of penicillin allergy that developed five years ago, the effectiveTime is five years ago. The effectiveTime of the Allergy - Intolerance Observation is the definitive indication of whether or not the underlying allergy/intolerance is resolved. If known to be resolved, then an effectiveTime/high would be present. If the date of resolution is not known, then effectiveTime/high will be present with a nullFlavor of "UNK". The agent responsible for an allergy or adverse reaction is not always a manufactured material (for example, food allergies), nor is it necessarily consumed. The following constraints reflect limitations in the base CDA R2 specification, and should be used to represent any type of responsible agent, i.e., use playingEntity classCode = "MMAT" for all agents, manufactured or not.

element.name: cda:observation

attribute.name: classCode
attribute.desc: SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] @classCode="OBS" Observation (CodeSystem: HL7ActClass urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.5.6 STATIC) (CONF:1098-7379).

attribute.name: moodCode
attribute.desc: SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] @moodCode="EVN" Event (CodeSystem: ActMood urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.5.1001 STATIC) (CONF:1098-7380).

element.name: cda:templateId
element.desc: C-CDA R1.1 templateId root without an extension

element.name: cda:templateId
element.desc: SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] templateId (CONF:1098-7381) such that it

element.name: cda:id
element.desc: SHALL contain at least one [1..*] id (CONF:1098-7382).

element.name: cda:low
element.desc: This effectiveTime SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] low (CONF:1098-31538).

element.name: cda:high
element.desc: This effectiveTime MAY contain zero or one [0..1] high (CONF:1098-31539).

element.name: cda:value
element.desc: SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] value with @xsi:type="CD", where the code SHALL be selected from ValueSet Allergy and Intolerance Type urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.3.88.12.3221.6.2 DYNAMIC (CONF:1098-7390).

element.name: cda:author
element.desc: SHOULD contain zero or more [0..*] Author Participation (identifier: urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.10.20.22.4.119) (CONF:1098-31143).

element.name: cda:participant
element.desc: SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] participant (CONF:1098-7402) such that it

attribute.name: typeCode
attribute.desc: SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] @typeCode="CSM" Consumable (CodeSystem: HL7ParticipationType urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.5.90 STATIC) (CONF:1098-7403).

attribute.name: classCode
attribute.desc: This participantRole SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] @classCode="MANU" Manufactured Product (CodeSystem: RoleClass urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.5.110 STATIC) (CONF:1098-7405).

element.name: cda:playingEntity
element.desc: This participantRole SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] playingEntity (CONF:1098-7406).

attribute.name: classCode
attribute.desc: This playingEntity SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] @classCode="MMAT" Manufactured Material (CodeSystem: EntityClass urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.5.41 STATIC) (CONF:1098-7407).

element.name: cda:code
element.desc: This playingEntity SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] code, which SHALL be selected from ValueSet Substance-Reactant for Intolerance urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113762.1.4.1010.1 DYNAMIC (CONF:1098-7419).

attribute.name: typeCode
attribute.desc: SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] @typeCode="MFST" Is Manifestation of (CodeSystem: HL7ActRelationshipType urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.5.1002 STATIC) (CONF:1098-7907).

attribute.name: typeCode
attribute.desc: SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] @typeCode="SUBJ" Has Subject (CodeSystem: HL7ActRelationshipType urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.5.1002 STATIC) (CONF:1098-9962).

span.style: color: rgb(128, 128, 128); font-family: Verdana, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px;

constraint.span: Use of the Severity Observation at this level of the Allergy-intolerance template is deprecated. It SHOULD NOT be used here.

attribute.name: typeCode
attribute.desc: SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] @typeCode="SUBJ" Has Subject (CodeSystem: HL7ActRelationshipType urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.5.1002) (CONF:1098-32911).

span.style: font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Geneva, sans-serif; font-size: 12px;

element.assert: Use of the Severity Observation at this level of the Allergy-intolerance template is deprecated. It SHOULD NOT be used here.
